title: HiringCafe Jobs Search output
description: The jobs found, one row per job in the default dataset (switch between the Jobs, Companies and Details views), plus a run summary record.

jobs.title: Jobs found (jobs)
jobs.description: Every saved job, newest first: title, company, places, remote or office, job type, seniority, years asked, published pay, skills, requirements, visa sponsorship, the employer's apply link and hiring system, and company facts; with details on, the description. Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: jobs HiringCafe listed, jobs matched and saved, checked links, notes about how the input was read, the settings used and the calls made.
